events.text: Rachel Ruysch was born in The Hague.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Rachel Ruysch was born on 3 June 1664 in The Hague

events.text: Ruysch was apprenticed to Willem van Aelst.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1679 , at age fifteen , Ruysch was apprenticed to Willem van Aelst

events.text: Ruysch studied with van Aelst until his death.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ruysch studied with van Aelst until his death in 1683

events.text: She married the Amsterdam portrait painter Juriaen Pool.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1693 she married the Amsterdam portrait painter Juriaen Pool

events.subject: self
events.quote: Ruysch died in Amsterdam on 12 October 1750

events.text: Ruysch and her family had moved to The Hague.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By 1699 she and her family had moved to The Hague

events.text: Ruysch was offered membership in the Confrerie Pictura as their first female member.
events.subject: self
events.quote: By 1699 she and her family had moved to The Hague , where she was offered membership in the Confrerie Pictura

events.text: Ruysch and her husband became members of The Hague Painters Guild.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1701 she and her husband became members of The Hague Painters Guild

events.text: Ruysch was invited to work for the court in Düsseldorf and serve as court painter to Johann Wilhelm, Elector Palatine.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1708 , Ruysch was invited to work for the court in Düsseldorf and serve as court painter to Johann Wilhelm

events.text: Ruysch continued working for him and his wife from 1708.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She continued working for him and his wife from 1708 until the princes death in 1716

events.text: Ruysch's work for him and his wife continued until the prince's death in 1716.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She continued working for him and his wife from 1708 until the princes death in 1716

events.subject: self
events.quote: When she died in 1750 , eleven poets paid her their respects with poems about her .

events.text: A painting by Ruysch was discovered in a farmhouse in Normandy and was sold at auction for 2.9 million French francs.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1999 a painting by Ruysch was discovered in a farmhouse in Normandy and was sold at auction for 2.9 million French francs

events.text: Leyster's work was added to the Gallery of Honor at the Rijksmuseum.
